title: DEC-001: Card data never stored on the device
body:
Decision summary

Status

Decided

Outcome

The mobile app never stores card numbers or CVV on the device. Checkout uses the payment provider's hosted tokenization and keeps only the token.

Applies to

payment, checkout, card, credit card

Do not

store card number, card cache, cache card details, save card on device, store CVV

Instead

Use hosted tokenization and keep only the payment token.

Decided on

2026-09-02

Owner

Mobile Platform lead

Why

Keeping card data off the device keeps the app out of the card-data compliance scope and removes a high-impact leak path.

title: DEC-002: First-party analytics only
body:
Decision summary

Status

Decided

Outcome

Product analytics go through our own event collector. No third-party analytics or session replay SDKs ship in the app.

Applies to

analytics, tracking, funnel, events, telemetry

Do not

third-party analytics SDK, analytics SDK, session replay, heatmap SDK

Instead

Send events to the internal event collector (schema in the Events catalog).

Decided on

2026-09-10

Owner

Data and Privacy lead

Why

Users were promised that behavioural data stays with us. Third-party SDKs also added 4 MB to the app bundle.

title: DEC-003: Minimum OS versions are iOS 16 and Android 10
body:
Decision summary

Status

Decided

Outcome

New releases support iOS 16 or later and Android 10 or later. Older versions only receive the last compatible build.

Applies to

minimum OS, legacy devices, iOS 15, Android 9, OS support

Do not

support iOS 15, support Android 9, lower the minimum OS

Instead

Point customers on older devices to the last compatible build.

Decided on

2026-08-21

Owner

Mobile Dev manager

Why

Testing matrix cost; less than 3 percent of active users were on older versions when this was decided.

title: DEC-004: Passwordless sign-in, no SMS codes
body:
Decision summary

Status

Decided

Outcome

Sign-in uses email magic links and passkeys. We do not add SMS one-time codes as a primary or fallback method.

Applies to

login, sign in, sign-in, authentication, one-time code, verification code, OTP

Do not

SMS OTP, SMS code, SMS verification, text message code

Instead

Improve magic-link delivery or offer a passkey prompt.

Decided on

2026-09-18

Owner

Identity team lead

Why

SIM-swap risk and per-message cost. Support tickets showed email delay is the real pain, not the method.

title: DEC-005: Every new feature ships behind a remote flag
body:
Decision summary

Status

Decided

Outcome

New user-facing features are released behind remote feature flags with a kill switch. Hardcoded or build-time toggles are not used for releases.

Applies to

feature flag, rollout, roll out, release, launch

Do not

hardcoded toggle, build-time flag, hardcoded flag

Instead

Create a remote flag with a kill switch before the first merge.

Decided on

2026-07-30

Owner

Release manager

Why

Two incidents in Q2 needed an app-store release to turn a feature off.

title: DEC-006: Offline mode is read-only
body:
Decision summary

Status

Superseded

Outcome

Offline mode only shows cached content. No writes are accepted while offline.

Applies to

offline, offline mode, sync

Do not

offline writes, offline edits

Instead

Show a read-only banner while offline.

Decided on

2026-05-12

Owner

Mobile Dev manager

Superseded by

DEC-007

Why

Conflict resolution was not designed yet.

title: DEC-007: Offline drafts for notes only
body:
Decision summary

Status

Decided

Outcome

While offline, users can create and edit note drafts, which sync on reconnect. Payments and checkout stay online-only.

Applies to

offline, offline mode, sync, drafts

Do not

offline payment, offline checkout, offline purchase

Instead

Queue note drafts locally and sync on reconnect; block checkout with a clear offline message.

Decided on

2026-10-06

Owner

Mobile Dev manager

Why

Replaces DEC-006 after the sync conflict design was approved.
